svg.title: Seedmap — offline Minecraft seed atlas
svg.desc: Enter a Minecraft Java 1.21.4 (Winter Drop) seed to explore its biomes and structures, read coordinates, measure a route, and read every enchanting table offer from a seed. Runs entirely offline in this single SVG file.

canvas.aria-label: Generated seed map. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, and press M to measure.

main.h1:
Every world starts
with a seed.
main.p: Browse biomes, structures and strongholds, read the coordinates, measure a route, or line up an enchanting table. One file, no network.

form.label: World seed
form.p: Try 42 · letters are hashed like Java Edition · 1.21.4 Winter Drop

aside.div: Click the map to place a point

div.p: Underground markers are placements, not entrances.

section.div: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · M to measure · Esc to leave
